messages:
anita-release: Heads up — planning an unpin of runtime 2.14.3 from hosted canary tonight at 23:00 UTC. Need confirmation on SDK compatibility and rollback criteria.

deploybot: Current pinlist shows runtime=2.14.3 mapped to llama3q, gptx2, quant-v3b. Unpin scheduled at 1768920000 (23:00 UTC). Will set canary targets.

kai-sre: Any known customers still on SDK 1.7/1.8 that could break?

maya-engineering: SDK 1.9+ is fully compatible. 1.8 had a shim relying on kv-cache ordering; 1.7 is risky. Recommend calling out SDK >=1.9.0 in notes.

tom-prd: Customer Nimbus (Dedicated) still on SDK 1.7. CS needs a heads-up; avoid breaking them. @anita-release can you coordinate?

anita-release: Will notify CS. Proposed rollout: staged unpin -> hosted/eu-west longseq only -> 30m monitor -> expand to global canary if green.

deploybot: Canary targets configured: hosted/eu-west tag=longseq 10% traffic. Command: ```deploybot unpin --runtime 2.14.3 --targets hosted:eu-west:tag=longseq --scheduled 1768920000```

lucas-ops: Monitoring hooks: error_rate, decode_failures, p99_latency, token_delivery_drops. Alert if error_rate > 0.7% OR decode_failures > 5/min -> rollback.

maya-engineering: Add tokenization-mismatch guard; if anomalies surface pause rollout and fallback affected models to 2.14.2.

anita-release: Rollback command: `deploybot pin --runtime 2.14.2 --scope hosted`. Follow staged-pin rollback runbook.

kai-sre: Mobile SDKs might still be 1.8/1.7; Nimbus will be auto-exempt until they upgrade.

tom-prd: CS confirms they'll notify Nimbus. They asked for 48h but agreed to limited canary in eu-west.

deploybot: Job queued (position 3). Will post when rollout begins.

anita-release: Update release notes: "KV cache ordering fix in 2.14.3; may affect SDK <=1.8"; recommend SDK >=1.9.0.

maya-engineering: Track model-level decode_failures and streaming timeouts. Abort if streaming timeouts > baseline +15% in first 10m.

lucas-ops: I'll spin up a 1m granularity dashboard and route alerts to #eng-oncall.

deploybot: Rollout started at 1768920000. Target: hosted/eu-west longseq, 10%.

anita-release: I'll draft a short announcement after 30m if green.

kai-sre: :thumbsup: watching logs.

tom-prd: CS ack, Nimbus notified.

deploybot: Canary update 1768920240: nothing above thresholds in first 4m. p99 +3% within tolerance.

maya-engineering: Seeing a few decode warnings on quant-v3b, no hard fails yet. Monitoring.

lucas-ops: 10m check: decode_failures 1/min, error_rate 0.08%, streaming timeouts stable. Continue.

deploybot: Canary green at 1768921800 (30m). Expanding to global canary (50% traffic) per plan.

anita-release: Expand and watch for 1h before full unpin.

maya-engineering: Added auto-rule: if any model group >0.5% decode_failures during expansion, auto-pin that group back to 2.14.2.

deploybot: Expansion started.

deploybot: Expansion update 1768925400: small spike in decode_failures for quant-v3b in us-west at 1768925300 -> 1.6/min, flagged.

lucas-ops: Increasing log retention and collecting traces.

anita-release: Pause full expansion, keep at 50% for 30m. No rollback yet. Notify CS.

tom-prd: CS reports one Nimbus tenant saw an output regression, logs submitted. Possible quant-v3b related.

maya-engineering: Investigating quant kernel fallback that changes chunking -> GC pressure -> occasional decode slowdowns. Patch available.

kai-sre: Quick-fix rollout could be faster, but safe option is pinback the affected model group while validating patch in canary.

anita-release: Proceed with regional pinback for quant-v3b in us-west, then ship patch to separate canary.

deploybot: Executing pinback: `deploybot pin --runtime 2.14.2 --models quant-v3b --scope hosted:us-west` -> started 1768927200.

deploybot: Pinback complete 1768927260. quant-v3b restored to 2.14.2 in hosted:us-west. Metrics returning to baseline.

anita-release: Thanks. We'll keep the rest of rollout paused until patch canary tomorrow. Update release notes and advisory: Dedicated customers on SDK <1.9 exempted.

tom-prd: CS will follow up with Nimbus and provide migration support.

maya-engineering: Opening follow-up thread for quick-fix patch canary. ETA for patch build ~3h.

lucas-ops: Dashboard will remain in heightened watch for 6h.

deploybot: Final status: unpin partially applied; region-specific pinback executed for quant-v3b. Thread closed for now; next steps in #eng-releases.

anita-release: :white_check_mark: Great coordination, thanks all.
